issues.description: QT4 modifier value in production.json quality_tier_effects is 1.20, but resolution.json and research.json both specify QT4=1.30. The MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING section also uses QT4(1.20) for worst_case_coating calculation (yielding 2.65x), whereas resolution.json computes QT4(1.3) x scaffold(1.60) x vented(1.15) x tg_board(1.20) = 2.87x. The binary task pace modifier is stated as 1.20x instead of 1.30x.
issues.suggested_fix: Update production.json quality_tier_effects.QT4.modifier from 1.20 to 1.30, and update MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.worst_case_coating from 'QT4(1.20)' to 'QT4(1.30)' with corrected product 2.87x. Update binary task pace modifier from 1.20x to 1.30x. This is a rate-impacting discrepancy that affects all QT4 binary task estimates.

issues.description: Protection zone 'ext_soffit_vent' is referenced in sop_modules.json protection_metadata (TSK_SFRP_VENT_MASK setup and TSK_SFRP_VENT_UNMASK teardown) but was not pre-resolved in resolution.json zone_ids. Resolution.json lists 7 zones; sop_modules.json protection_metadata defines 8 zones (adding ext_soffit_vent). This is a valid RP_NEW zone addition by the SOP Librarian for vent masking, but it was not flagged in resolution.json registry_additions_proposed.
issues.suggested_fix: Add ext_soffit_vent to resolution.json zone_ids and registry_additions_proposed for completeness. No functional impact — the zone is correctly wired in sop_modules.json with proper setup/teardown tasks.

observations.description: SOP and production task_count_summary show slightly different transfer type breakdowns. SOP: 24 DIRECT_REKEYED + 8 MODIFIED + 14 RP_NEW + 5 SHARED_RRP. Production: 19 DIRECT_from_NC + 9 MODIFIED_from_NC + 18 RP_NEW + 5 SHARED_RRP. Total is 51 in both files. The discrepancy is classification methodology — some tasks classified as DIRECT in SOP are reclassified as MODIFIED or RP_NEW in production due to rate adjustment. No functional impact — task_id and UOM threading is correct.

Resolution.json expected_modules lists 10 modules (including separate MOD_SFRP_WASH and MOD_SFRP_FINAL_INSPECT). SOP Librarian consolidated: wash tasks merged into MOD_SFRP_PREP, final inspect merged into MOD_SFRP_CLEANUP, producing 8 modules (7 owned + 1 shared RRP). This is a valid structural optimization — all tasks are present, just reorganized into fewer modules. No tasks lost.

Materials Manager added two coverage profiles not in resolution.json proposed list: COV_SFRP_PRIMER_ALKALI_SPOT and COV_SFRP_PRIMER_BONDING_SPOT. Resolution proposed COV_SFRP_PRIMER_CHALK_BIND, COV_SFRP_PRIMER_ACRYLIC_RP, and COV_SFRP_FINISH (3 profiles). Materials.json delivers 5 profiles total. The additions correctly cover spot-priming scenarios for alkali-resistant and bonding primers on exposed substrate areas. Valid enrichment.

Prep pool worst-case theoretical stacking is 8.83x (POOR 2.0 x RRP 2.0 x scaffold 1.60 x vented 1.15 x tg_board 1.20), which exceeds the 4.0x cap. Both resolution.json and production.json flag this as an extreme unrealistic scenario and recommend T&M for this edge case. Realistic worst case is 2.33x (within cap). This is correctly documented and acknowledged.
